arStrings.szText: {c_important}Pulverize{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_39*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies and Bosses.
Enemies hit with {c_important}Pulverize{/c} deal {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%|]{/c} reduced damage for {c_number}{buffduration:MOD_DAMAGE_REDUCTION}{/c} seconds.

Every {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds, {c_important}Pulverize{/c} is guaranteed to {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} and make enemies take {c_number}[SF_25*100|x%|]{/c} more damage for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Pulverize{/c} costs {c_number}[SF_24 * 100|%x|]{/c} more Spirit, and deals {c_number}[SF_25 * 100|%x|]{/c} more damage.
